arxiv-2111-02438.title: No second law of entanglement manipulation after all
arxiv-2111-02438.creator: Ludovico Lami, Bartosz Regula
arxiv-2111-02438.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Ludovico Lami, Bartosz Regula. Many fruitful analogies have emerged between the theories of quantum entanglement and thermodynamics, motivating the pursuit of an axiomatic description of entanglement akin to the laws of thermodynamics. A long-standing open problem has been to establish a true second law of entanglement, and in particular a unique function which governs all transformations between entangled systems, mirroring the role of entropy in thermodynamics.

arxiv-2311-12899.creator: Shrinit Singh
arxiv-2311-12899.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Shrinit Singh. A word w w in a free group is called chiral if there exists a group G G such that image of word map corresponding to word w w is not closed with respect to inverse. Similarly a group G G is said to be chiral if there exists a word w w in free group such that w w exhibits chirality on the group G G .

arxiv-2404-04949.creator: Yuhang Zhou, Zeping Li, Siyu Tian, Yuchen Ni, Sen Liu, Guangnan Ye, Hongfeng Chai
arxiv-2404-04949.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being applied across various specialized fields, leveraging their extensive knowledge to empower a multitude of scenarios within these domains. However, each field encompasses a variety of specific tasks that require learning, and the diverse, heterogeneous data across these domains can lead to conflicts during model task transfer.

arxiv-2409-02241.title: What Makes a Face Look Like a Hat: Decoupling Low-level and High-level Visual Properties with Image Triplets
arxiv-2409-02241.creator: Maytus Piriyajitakonkij, Sirawaj Itthipuripat, Ian Ballard, Ioannis Pappas
arxiv-2409-02241.description: Abstract In visual decision making, high-level features, such as object categories, have a strong influence on choice. However, the impact of low-level features on behavior is less understood partly due to the high correlation between high- and low-level features in the stimuli presented (e.g., objects of the same category are more likely to share low-level features).

arxiv-2504-18611.title: Quintessence and False vacuum: Two sides of the same coin?
arxiv-2504-18611.creator: Pradosh Keshav MV, Kenath Arun
arxiv-2504-18611.description: Abstract We study late-time acceleration scenarios using a quintessence field initially trapped in a metastable false vacuum state. The false vacuum has non-zero vacuum energy and could drive exponential expansion if not coupled with gravity. Upon decay of the false vacuum, the quintessence field is released and begins to evolve.

arxiv-2509-01069.title: A magnetic white dwarf formed through a binary merger within 35 million years Facilities: Gaia (DR3), Gemini-North (GMOS), Keck:I (LRIS), Zwicky Transient Facility (DR 23)
arxiv-2509-01069.creator: Huahui Yan, Jiamao Lin, Rizhong Zheng, Li Wang, Genghao Liu, Liangliang Ren, Zhen Guo, Siyi Xu, Zhangliang Chen, Chun Chen, Bo Ma, Yong Shao, Zhenwei Li, Xianfei Zhang, Christoffer Fremling, Jan J. Eldridge, Hongwei Ge, Chengyuan Li
arxiv-2509-01069.description: Abstract White dwarfs (WDs) represent the final evolutionary stage of most stars, typically originating from progenitor stars with masses below approximately 8 M ⊙ M_{\odot} to 10 M ⊙ M_{\odot} . Formation through single-star evolution generally requires at least 25 Myr, with the youngest WDs often near the Chandrasekhar limit of 1.4 M ⊙ M_{\odot} .

arxiv-2510-11295.title: Human Uncertainty-Aware Data Selection and Automatic Labeling in Visual Question Answering
arxiv-2510-11295.creator: Jian Lan, Zhicheng Liu, Udo Schlegel, Raoyuan Zhao, Yihong Liu, Hinrich Schütze, Michael A. Hedderich, Thomas Seidl
arxiv-2510-11295.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jian Lan, Zhicheng Liu, Udo Schlegel, Raoyuan Zhao, Yihong Liu, Hinrich Schütze, Michael A. Hedderich, Thomas Seidl. Large vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong performance in Visual Question Answering but still rely heavily on supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with massive labeled datasets, which is costly due to human annotations. Crucially, real-world datasets often exhibit human uncertainty ( HU ) – variation in human confidence across annotations, but standard SFT simply optimizes toward the most frequent label, disregarding HU distributions.

pmc-13478592.title: A universal scaling framework for granular asteroid strength and its application to the surface of asteroid Bennu
pmc-13478592.creator: Paul Sánchez, Emilien Azéma, Keanna Jardine, Christian G Hoover, Jens Biele, Andrew J Ryan, Ronald-L Ballouz, Robert J Macke, Maurizio Pajola, Harold C Connolly Jr, Dante S Lauretta
pmc-13478592.description: Granular asteroids exhibit surprising structural stability despite low gravity and high spin rates. Understanding the mechanisms behind their strength is essential for predicting their evolution and informing deflection strategies. Using 3D particle-dynamics simulations, we develop a scaling framework for the tensile strength of cohesive, self-gravitating regolith, examining how particle size and shape jointly control macroscopic behavior.

uslaw-usc-t22-s2801.title: 22 U.S.C. § 2801 — Congressional findings
uslaw-usc-t22-s2801.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t22-s2801.description: United States Code, Title 22 (Foreign Relations And Intercourse); Chapter 40 (International Expositions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Congress finds that— (a) international expositions, when properly organized, financed, and executed, have a significant impact on the economic growth of the region surrounding the exposition and, under appropriate international sanction, are important instruments of national policy, particularly in the exchange of ideas.
